audit.git_rationale: Git-metadata dependent: the measurement records git rev-parse HEAD as the candidate revision. These records are fresh backend executions, which the helper never reuses.
audit.input_rationale: Inputs are the whole task worktree (hashed, nothing excluded), the Go launcher at /usr/local/go, and the Go module cache at /home/user/go/pkg/mod, which holds every resolved module; go.mod names go 1.24.0, which the installed launcher provides. GOCACHE points at a fresh empty directory for each run, so no earlier build output is reused. The Make target runs scripts/go-test-require-tests.sh (bash, tee, mktemp, grep, awk) and its own recipe (mktemp, grep, cat, rm) through VALIDATION_CHILD_ENV (env), and the measurement test reads the candidate revision with git. The database is a disposable owned fixture that this helper prepares and removes; its server is the backend probe. HOME is inventoried by fingerprint and the target reads no HOME configuration. No output directory is excluded. The SingleStore server is a disposable local container of ghcr.io/singlestore-labs/singlestoredb-dev@sha256:2f181587a74b63a83e7dbd46b02e9dce031b8cacf1f5651bff297b2d8c87df37 (--cpus=4 --memory=4g, as in ci.yml).
